full_name: Constance Merritt | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: According to distinguished poet Eleanor Wilner, Constance Merritt is “a poet to defeat categories, to oppose the ‘tyranny of names’ with a poetry that sets its own terms of encounter . . . tender and austere, formal and intimate at once.”
